title: helianthus debilis subsp. vestitus
intro: Helianthus debilis subsp. vestitus, commonly known as the prairie sunflower or beach sunflower, is a subspecies of the Helianthus debilis plant, native to the Americas. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, with its reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Helianthus debilis subsp. vestitus include wound healing, skin protection, and immune system modulation, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for its potential therapeutic effects, although further research is necessary to confirm its efficacy and safety for human use.
